Done. The plan at `out/T3/plan.yaml` ran once and passed every check.

What the plan does, in order:
- Deletes the 48 buffers with a regex on `attention.(bias|masked_bias|rotary_emb.inv_freq)`.
- Upcasts every remaining tensor to float32 in place.
- Downcasts the 64 projection matrices to bfloat16 using an explicit regex on the four projection names per layer, avoiding the `.*weight` overreach.
- Asserts: 64 matches for the projection regex, all bfloat16, layer 0 query_key_value is bfloat16, embed_in is float32, every non-projection tensor is float32, and total count is 196.
- Writes sharded safetensors to `out/T3` with a 256MB shard budget.

Output verified independently:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Tensors in index | 196 |
| bfloat16 / float32 | 64 / 132 |
| Shards | 9, plus index file |
| Shards over 256 MiB | 2, each holding only one embedding matrix (allowed) |

The self-report is at `out/T3/REPORT.md`. One execution, no failures.
